CUSTEXT.cbl.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTEXT.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-PK-CHUNKING-FLAG    PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-CHUNK-SIZE          PIC 9(08) VALUE 50000.
       01  WS-CUST-REC.
           05  WS-CUST-ID         PIC X(10).
           05  WS-CUST-NAME       PIC X(40).
           05  WS-SSN             PIC X(09).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           IF WS-PK-CHUNKING-FLAG = 'Y'
              PERFORM PK-CHUNK-EXTRACT
           ELSE
              PERFORM FULL-TABLE-EXTRACT
           END-IF.
           GOBACK.
       PK-CHUNK-EXTRACT.
           DISPLAY 'PK CHUNKING ENABLED SIZE=' WS-CHUNK-SIZE.
           * Informatica session expects chunk keys
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-DONE = 'Y'
              CALL 'INFAPK' USING WS-CHUNK-SIZE
           END-PERFORM.
       FULL-TABLE-EXTRACT.
           DISPLAY 'FULL EXTRACT MODE'.
           CALL 'INFAEXT' USING WS-CUST-REC.

PAYTRN.cbl.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PAYTRN.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           EXEC CICS READ FILE('PAYFILE') INTO(WS-PAY) END-EXEC.
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
